handoff: Approve: review#1 F1-F5 resolved. Uncommitted runs/ deletions come from git status; a deferred, refused or thrown move commit fails and is retried; holds makes the move wait on any broken unit. In a tick the move commit is the only path for the deletions, except minor R2-F1 (a corrupt story record plus leftover deletions still runs storyLifecycle's add -A commits) and nit R2-F2 (an agent's own commit). Unit 1208, integration 730/6 skip, typecheck green.

findings.title: A story whose own record is corrupt, with leftover runs/ deletions, can have them swept by a storyLifecycle commit
findings.detail:
wait() emits record.move_waits only for units without errors. When the story unit itself has errors and its worktree holds uncommitted runs/ deletions (branch_record with copy []), the story key stays unoccupied. storyLifecycle (story.ts:121) then runs before decideUnit marks the unit corrupt. Its update_story_mirror commit (lifecycle.ts:244), park, mark_done or close commit uses act.commit without paths, which runs git add -A and would carry the deletions under another message. This needs a corrupt story record plus an interrupted move, so it is very unlikely, but it is the one tick path that does not keep the move commit the only one.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Keep the story key occupied while its branch_record waits, for example by skipping storyLifecycle when the story unit carries a branch_record. Or limit storyLifecycle's commits to their own paths.

findings.title: An agent working in the worktree can sweep the deletions before the move commit lands
findings.detail:
The move runs even while an agent session is live in the worktree. Between removeTreeRunState and the commit, or for a whole tick after a failed commit, an agent's own `git add -A && git commit` takes the deletions. Nothing is lost, since the copies land first, but the removal then sits in the agent's commit. norn cannot prevent this, and the spec does not ask the move to wait for an idle session.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Optional: name this limit in the moveRecord comment, or let the move wait for no live run in that worktree.
